name: Jeeter Infused Preroll | WC26 Mangonada (MEX - 2/6)
description:
Jeeter WC 26 Limited Edition Drop- 6 Half Gram Pre-Rolls

Jeeter celebrates soccer on the world stage.

6 countries. 6 infused half-grams. One collectible soccer ball.

Built to be displayed, this commemorative release features 6 half-gram infused pre-rolls representing countries from around the world:

• Argentina — Dulce de Messi (Indica)

• Portugal — CR OG (Indica)

• Colombia — Pibe OG (Hybrid)

• Japan — Purple Mochi (Hybrid)

• USA — American Pi (Sativa)

• Mexico — Mangonada (Sativa)

Designed to display open, with 6 additional slots to house your Jeeter All-In-One vapes — completing the full lineup. (Vapes Sold Separately)
